svg.title: Shinrai Ou — Throne of Thunder. Draft 3 / Storm classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 8 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Mandate of Thunder forks into Vajra Tempering then Thunder King's Wrath, or Lightning Rod then Judgement from Above. Raiment of Storms forks into Galvanic Rebuke then Thunder Answers Thunder. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Storm-classified Shinrai Ou jutsu.

Its only supported enemy debuff is Hammer's 35% Increase Damage Taken on area enemies, which anchors the exposure route; its only defensive row is the Storm Cloak's 40% Reflect, which anchors the bulwark route. Increase Damage Given has three rows (two on the Cloak, one on Raijin) whose percentages add to each other, with the bloodline's own IDG passive multiplying on top, so it is kept as Foundation and capstone-secondary glue capped at +5 rather than given a route of its own."},"nodes":[{"id":"01","name":"Mandate of Thunder","category":"Foundation","cost":1,"parents":[],"modifiers":[{"tag":"increasedamagegiven","flat":2,"display_role":"SELF BUFF"},{"tag":"increasedamagetaken","flat":2,"display_role":"ENEMY DEBUFF"}],"flavor":"Heaven names its king in thunder; the storm answers before the title is spoken.","coverage_note":"Storm Cloak IDG rows 0 and 2 and Raijin IDG (35%, self, 2 rounds); Hammer exposure (35%, area enemies, 2 rounds). BUFF","adverse":false,"base":1.0,"gain":0,"final":1.0,"calculation":"static","supported":false,"capped_at_100":false}],"advanced_arts":["Thunder Answers Thunder"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":"Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has four supported tags on nine rows (Damage x4, Increase Damage Given x3, Increase Damage Taken x1, Reflect x1). Mandate of Thunder forks into a damage route and an exposure route; Raiment of Storms carries a single Reflect chain. IDG gets no route of its own: two of its three rows sit on the same 40 AP Storm Cloak cast and the bloodline's IDG passive multiplies on top, so a dedicated route would push IDG past Taiyo Kami's doubled-row +5 or only mirror the Reflect capstone's secondary. Mandate of Thunder is therefore a universal node (in all 8 legal full builds): Raiment's 3-BP chain needs a fourth purchase and Mandate is the only prerequisite-closed one. A leaf Hidden Art under Raiment would be filler; every single-tag version was checked against the legal builds: +1 or +2 IDG and +2 IDT leave 06, 07, 08 plus the leaf dominated by 01, 06, 07, 08; +3 IDG lifts IDG to +6; +1 or +2 Damage leaves 01, 02, 06 plus the leaf dominated by the Burst build (+2 also twins Vajra Tempering's builds); +3 IDT twins Lightning Rod's builds and +4 IDT dominates both Lightning Rod hybrids; any Reflect lifts Reflect past +10. Only a split leaf (+1 Damage with +1 IDG or +1/+2 IDT) avoids all of these, and a one- or two-point sliver of tags other nodes already own has no role of its own. Burst and Exposure each keep two fourth-purchase choices; Bulwark has one. Three distinct complete builds exist.","design_notes":["Reference reuse: Mandate, Vajra Tempering and Thunder King's Wrath copy Taiyo Kami's Dawnheart, Crown of Cinders and Solar Cataclysm flats verbatim (+2 IDG/+2 IDT, +2 Damage, +3 Damage); Thunder Answers Thunder mirrors Sovereign Sun (+5/+3 IDG). It fits: same rank A / Highest / Burst profile and nine supported rows. Departures: Damage reaches four rows (Taiyo three) and Raiment adds +1, so it tops at +6 (Taiyo +5); no Afterburn, DDT or DDG rows, so IDT and Reflect each run 2/3/5 to +10.","Main tree and passives: both Cloak IDG rows match the kit's Storm hits (row 0 via its Highest stat filter, row 2 via Storm) and add to Raijin's IDG: three 35% rows add 105% of the staged base (120% at the +5 ceiling), and the bloodline passive IDG (25 + 0.15/lvl) multiplies on top. Enhanced IDG also reaches normal jutsu and weapons (row 0 and Raijin: Highest-stat or element-less hits; row 2: Storm, Lightning, Water or element-less). Skill-tree effects are off in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING.","Uptime: cooldown 7 on all five jutsu (attacks 60 AP, Cloak 40 AP) outlasts every two-round window. Each buff and the exposure is live only in the two rounds after its cast, never on its own jutsu's hit, so Raijin's IDG and Hammer's exposure feed the other attacks, normal jutsu and weapons, not their own next cast. Staggered Cloak and Raijin casts give about four of seven rounds of enhanced IDG. Both IDG sources land on the caster at cast time; Hammer's exposure sits on its tiles.","Fourth-purchase choices: Burst (01, 02, 03) finishes with Lightning Rod (exposure 40%) or Raiment of Storms (Reflect 42%, Damage +6); Exposure (01, 04, 05) finishes with Vajra Tempering (Damage +2) or Raiment of Storms; Bulwark (06, 07, 08) finishes only with Mandate of Thunder (see the narrow-kit exception). Hybrids without a capstone (for example 01, 02, 04, 06 or 01, 02, 06, 07) spread +2 to +5 across all four tags and stay non-dominated.","Reflect and untouched rows: the Cloak Reflect row lists all four stat types and no element, so it matches effectively every hit the caster takes, pierce included; the return bypasses shields, and other Reflect sources add to it up to the 60%-of-hit cap (50% leaves ten points). Daibutsu's recoil 40%, Railgun's stun 100 and the two move rows are unsupported and unchanged; the bloodline passives (IDG; 15% Decrease Damage Taken against Lightning) are not potency targets.","Value options (user-owned; flats unchanged): Burst (01, 02, 03, 06) is row-weighted 34 and Exposure (01, 02, 04, 05) 33 against Taiyo Kami's 31. Damage: (a) Thunder King's Wrath +2 (ceiling +5, Burst 30); (b) drop Raiment's +1 Damage (Burst 30; a +1 IDT swap makes 01, 04, 05, 06 IDT +11, a +1 IDG swap makes 01, 06, 07, 08 IDG +6); (c) keep +6 (OPEN_DECISIONS D8). Exposure: Judgement from Above +3 IDT (route +8, Hammer 43%, Exposure 31) or keep +10 on the one team row (D14)."],"risks":["Classification: Storm is not exclusive in the census (Arashima and Godstorm Eclipse are INCLUDE kits with Storm damage rows; Stormboat Willy is deferred), and whether any NORMAL/SPECIAL/EVENT/FORBIDDEN jutsu carries Storm is unverified. The tree assumes a bloodline-scoped whole-kit classification; a bare element match would leak every node to those kits.","Resolver: 3 of the 9 supported rows (Storm Cloak IDG row 0, Storm Cloak Reflect, Raijin IDG) have no element and fall back to None under the current resolver, so they are unreachable without the proposed classification change; reaching them with affectedElements including None would also reach every element-less row on any jutsu the player casts.","IDG stacking: with both Cloak rows and Raijin live, three 35% rows add 105% of the staged base before the multiplying bloodline passive; the +5 ceiling adds 15 more points (120%). Each row stays far below the 100 cap, but the combined per-hit amplification is high and was not simulated against peer kits.","Open balance decisions (user-owned, not applied): Burst (01, 02, 03, 06) puts Damage +6 on all four damage rows, row-weighted 34 against Taiyo Kami's 31 (+5 on three rows). Exposure takes Hammer's team-amplifying area IDT to +10 (45%; allies' matching non-pierce hits gain too), at the guardrail and above Taiyo's +7; row-weighted 33. Options: design note 6 (OPEN_DECISIONS D8, D14).","Reflect cap and uptime: other Reflect sources (main tree, items) add to the Cloak's 50% and could saturate the 60%-of-pre-shield-damage cap, wasting part of the +10. Reflect pays only when the caster is hit in the two rounds after the Cloak's cast (tags.ts reflect: !isNew && !castThisRound), so the bulwark is a duelist's build with no Decrease Damage Taken row to pair. Not simulated.","Universal node: Mandate of Thunder is in all 8 legal full-budget builds because the bulwark chain has no other prerequisite-closed fourth purchase, so the 4-BP budget carries 3 BP of real choice. Accepted under the narrow-kit exception, which records why every leaf under Raiment of Storms would be filler (dominated, a twin, or past a ceiling).","Delivery: Daibutsu Thunder (radius-1 spawn on an OTHER_USER target), Raijin (ground circle spawn) and Hammer (spiral around the caster) are area deliveries; realized hits and exposure depend on positioning. Every harmful row is friendly fire ENEMIES, so no ally hazards; Daibutsu or Railgun aimed at an ally withholds its ENEMIES rows from that ally. g.text: Draft 3 / Storm classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Shinrai Ou jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Thunder King's Wrath path + Raiment of Storms
Judgement from Above path + Vajra Tempering
Thunder Answers Thunder path + Mandate of Thunder
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · REF: Reflect
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Storm Cloak · Increase Damage Given (each of 2 effects)
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Lifesteal shares a 60%-of-hit leech budget with vamp; Reflect returns at most 60% of a hit.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
8 legal four-skill allocations · 3 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
